name: Neural Radar
description: A live neural map of your running agents and their subagents. You sit at the centre; the more an agent needs you, the closer it moves. Click an agent to jump to its session, approve a plan, send it a message or stop it.
author: eskwisit

en.name: Neural Radar
en.description: A live neural map of your running agents and their subagents. You sit at the centre; the more an agent needs you, the closer it moves. Click an agent to jump to its session, approve a plan, send it a message or stop it.
en.safetyNotes: Uses the high-risk desktop.control permission to read the session list, agent status, transcripts (last 60 messages), subagents and pending plans, and, only when you click in the drawer, to open a session, send a message, approve or reject a plan, or stop or abort a turn (stop and abort need a second confirming click). ui.view docks the radar in the work panel. notify shows a system notification and an in-app notice when an agent needs you; turn it off in the plugin settings. No network access. Your picture, which you pick by clicking your circle in the radar, is kept in its data folder (removed when you right-click your circle). Nothing else is stored besides its settings.

zh-CN.name: 神经雷达
zh-CN.description: 实时神经网络图，展示正在运行的智能体及其子智能体。你位于中心，越需要你的智能体离你越近。点击智能体即可跳转到它的会话、批准计划、发送消息或停止它。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 使用高风险权限 desktop.control 读取会话列表、智能体状态、对话记录（最近 60 条消息）、子智能体和待批准的计划；只有在你于抽屉中点击时，才会打开会话、发送消息、批准或拒绝计划、停止或中止当前轮次（停止和中止需要再次点击确认）。ui.view 将雷达停靠在工作面板中。notify 在智能体需要你时显示系统通知和应用内提示，可在插件设置中关闭。不访问网络。点击雷达中你的圆圈选择的头像保存在插件数据文件夹中（右键点击圆圈即删除）。除此之外只存储自身设置。

changelog: Click your circle to set your picture (no more picture settings, no network), tooltips of agents that need you turn fully opaque, and an open radar reloads itself after an update.
